# Filter rows where Height contains a numeric value greater than 1.8 meters
# The height column contains strings like "1.83 m (6 ft 0 in)", we need to extract the numeric part before "m"
# Extract the numeric part before "m" and convert to float
df['height_m'] = df['Height'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)').astype(float)

# Filter candidates with height > 1.8
over_180 = df[df['height_m'] > 1.8]

# Count the number of unique candidates (rows) that satisfy the condition
